channels.channel: DownloadStateData body sha256 vs Phase 10–16 baseline
channels.rationale: Live Phase 17 download matches baseline byte-for-byte; no source-data drift. Sha256 identity is integrity evidence, not an ISO export date.
Filename MMDDYYYY is an attachment label only; not an official ISO export timestamp.
Response headers omit Last-Modified on RCFE and ARF downloads.
No ETag observed on DownloadStateData responses.
HTTP Date is the response generation clock, not a dataset export date.
Retrieval timestamp must never substitute for an authoritative export date.

channels.channel: Transparency FAQ Download Data: How often is the data updated?
channels.observedValue: Official FAQ answer under <downloaddata>: "The data is updated weekly."
channels.rationale: Authoritative CDSS cadence statement, but weekly cadence alone does not identify the ISO export date of a specific DownloadStateData attachment.

channels.channel: Transparency FAQ Facility Detail: Why "No date on file" for a license date?
channels.observedValue: "The department will be adding additional information in future weeks. In some circumstances, the exact first license date may not be available."
channels.rationale: Explains missing license-first dates on some facilities; does not provide a roster export ISO date and does not authorize publishing LICENSED rows without dates.

channels.channel: downloadstatedata.html CalHHS Open Data Portal copy note
channels.observedValue: "A copy of this data is regularly published to the CalHHS Open Data Portal"
channels.rationale: 'Regularly' is not an ISO export date; CHHS clocks remain non-authoritative for DownloadStateData.
Client application version stamps are not DownloadStateData roster export dates.
